record.name: Airtable
record.one_liner: Airtable is a cloud-based collaboration platform that combines the features of a database with the user interface of a spreadsheet.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free account and generate personal access tokens or configure OAuth in the Airtable developer hub.
record.api_note: The REST API covers bases, tables, records, comments, webhooks, and metadata.

evidence.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.
Our Free plan is available at no cost for users just getting started.
Any MCP-compatible tool can read, write, and query your bases through natural language
Using Airtable's MCP server, AI tools can query your Airtable data
